purpose: `InputModeServiceClient` classifies local Roblox input without reducing the player to a device or platform. A keyboard, mouse, touch surface, and gamepad can all be connected at once; the package tracks which input family was used most recently.
description: `InputModeServiceClient` classifies local Roblox input without reducing the player to a device or platform. A keyboard, mouse, touch surface, and gamepad can all be connected at once; the package tracks which input family was used most recently.

Client/InputMode.luau.description: Tracks when a static [InputModeType] is used. Public entry points include `InputMode.new`, `InputMode.isInputMode`, `InputMode.GetLastEnabledTime`, `InputMode.GetKeys`, `InputMode.IsValid`, `InputMode.Enable`, `InputMode.Evaluate`, `InputMode.Destroy`.

Client/InputModeProcessor.luau.description: Evaluates InputObjects against a collection of [InputMode] states. Public entry points include `InputModeProcessor.new`, `InputModeProcessor.AddInputMode`, `InputModeProcessor.GetStates`, `InputModeProcessor.Evaluate`, `InputModeProcessor.Destroy`.

Client/InputModeServiceClient.luau.description: Centralizes local input processing and exposes reusable InputMode state. Public entry points include `InputModeServiceClient.Init`, `InputModeServiceClient.Start`, `InputModeServiceClient.GetInputMode`, `InputModeServiceClient.Destroy`.

Client/InputModeTypeSelector.luau.description: Selects the most recently used mode from an ordered set of InputModeTypes. Public entry points include `InputModeTypeSelector.new`, `InputModeTypeSelector.fromObservableBrio`, `InputModeTypeSelector.GetActiveInputType`, `InputModeTypeSelector.ObserveActiveInputType`, `InputModeTypeSelector.IsActive`, `InputModeTypeSelector.ObserveIsActive`, `InputModeTypeSelector.Bind`, `onChange`.

Shared/InputModeType.luau.description: Defines a static group of input keys used by [InputMode]. Definitions can include other InputModeTypes to form composite modes. Public entry points include `InputModeType.new`, `InputModeType.isInputModeType`, `InputModeType.IsValid`, `InputModeType.GetKeys`.

Shared/InputModeTypes.luau.description: Predefined input mode definitions shared by input selectors and keybinding validation.
